title: Upload G5 battery stats to NS device status
body:
Currently G5 battery stats are culled daily.
Could we get them uploaded to NS before they are culled so they can be reported/analysed.

comments.body: I've been hoping for this too, so I can do some graphing/analytics on how long transmitters last. Check out PR https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/584
